title: The day I stopped
doing it their way
slides.body: I followed the advice everyone gives for two years. Here's what it cost me, and the one decision that changed it.

title: I did everything
{{right.}}
slides.body: On paper it was working. **It wasn't.** I was busy, booked, and quietly building someone else's idea of success.

slides.before: What your life or work looked like then.
The safe option you turned down.
The fear you had about changing.
slides.takeaway: The proof it was the right call.

title: You can be doing
everything right
and still be wrong.
slides.body: The hardest pivots aren't away from failure. They're away from a success that was never yours.

title: What are you
tolerating?
slides.body: End with a question or an invitation that mirrors your reader's own quiet decision. One move only.
slides.cta: If this is you, let's talk →
